title:
You don’t have to
face this alone.
intro: Take a breath. We’ll help you turn what happened into a clear complaint, one step at a time.
languageHint: Choose the language you feel most comfortable with.
privacyTitle: You’re in control of your story.
privacy: Your answers stay in this browser tab. Nothing is sent to police or a server. Closing or refreshing the tab clears them unless you download an encrypted backup. We will never ask for an OTP, PIN, password or CVV.
consent: I understand and agree to use my answers to prepare this complaint.
question_name: What name should we use for your complaint?
question_contact: How can the authorities contact you?
question_location: Which city and state do you live in?
question_amount: How much money did you lose, if any?
question_transaction: Do you have any transaction reference numbers?
question_suspect: What do you know about the person or account involved?
question_platform: Which app, website or platform was involved?
question_narrative: Tell us what happened, in your own words.
name: Full name
reviewHint: Check every detail. Your original words are preserved.
evidenceHint: Screenshots, receipts and conversations can help tell your story. Add only what you feel safe sharing.
consentReview: I have reviewed this draft and confirm that it reflects my account.
